measurementLimits: L6 probes and L7 are one hot instrument/partition on local 10-CPU Docker host; historical hosted C5 10k used 64 instruments, 16 partitions, and four materializers
Accepted-to-receipt gap counts in-flight trades at samples; it is not individual latency or settlement finality
L7 accepted 7,258.61 orders/s under a 7,500/s offered target and 95% acceptance gate; its sampled gap values were lower bounds, so tail gate was unproven
L8 used a corrected conservative upper-gap sampler; 7,500/s offered intake failed on increasingly aged local volumes despite exact downstream reconciliation
L9 passed 5,000/s offered on fresh generation 21 and the same further-aged host with the corrected sampler and exact stage reconciliation; this is one local single-lane sample
The high-rate Go generator was finalized after L7; its explicit gate fields and conservative gap samples were subsequently added
